WOFF2 conformance fixtures
==========================

Every .woff2 file here was produced by a tool that is independent of this repository. Every
"*-decoded.*" file is the output of an independent decoder for the .woff2 file of the same name.
Nothing in this directory was written by the engine under test.

Tools
-----
- Reference implementation: woff2_compress, woff2_decompress, woff2_info
  (Debian/Ubuntu package "woff2" 1.0.2-2build1)
- fontTools 4.66.1 with brotli 1.2.0 (python3 -m pip install fonttools brotli)

Source fonts (generate-sources.py <dir> rebuilds them from system fonts and fontTools)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dejavu-sans-latin.ttf          DejaVu Sans subset (U+0020-007E, U+00C0-00FF; kern and liga kept, hinting
                               dropped). Real TrueType font with composite glyphs (accented letters).
                               Licence: Bitstream Vera / DejaVu font licence (free redistribution of modified
                               fonts under a name other than "Bitstream" or "Vera").
dejavu-serif-hinted-ascii.ttf  DejaVu Serif subset (ASCII), hinting kept: fpgm, prep, cvt and per-glyph
                               instructions. Same licence.
synthetic-triplets.ttf         Generated by generate-sources.py with fontTools FontBuilder. Contains a glyph for
                               every coordinate encoding of the glyf transform (1, 2, 3 and 4 byte triplets),
                               a contour of 300 points (multi byte 255UInt16), an overlapSimple glyph, an empty
                               glyph, instruction programs of 300 and 600 bytes, and composite glyphs (word
                               offsets, scale and 2x2 components, 1000 byte composite instructions).
synthetic-cff.otf              Generated by generate-sources.py. OpenType font with CFF outlines (no glyf).
pair.ttc                       TrueType Collection of dejavu-sans-latin.ttf and synthetic-triplets.ttf,
                               written by fontTools TTCollection with shareTables=True.

Reference encodings
-------------------
<name>.reference.woff2            woff2_compress <name>.<ext>     (glyf/loca transformed, hmtx untransformed;
                               pair.reference.woff2 is a WOFF2 collection)
<name>.fonttools-hmtx.woff2    fontTools TTFont.save() with flavor "woff2" and
                               flavorData.transformedTables = {"glyf", "loca", "hmtx"}, so the optional
                               hmtx transform is present (the reference encoder never emits it)

Reference decodings
-------------------
<name>.reference-decoded.<ext>    woff2_decompress <name>.reference.woff2
<name>.fonttools-hmtx.reference-decoded.ttf
                               woff2_decompress <name>.fonttools-hmtx.woff2

The reference decoder pads every reconstructed glyph to four bytes and recomputes head.checkSumAdjustment,
so its glyf, loca and head differ from the source font; hmtx, cmap, name, post and the layout tables are
byte identical to the source.
